messages:
Jess (docs): heads-up — full site link-scan turned up ~38 internal links pointing at /runbooks/ops/* that now 404 after the KB slug migration. sample: https://kb.redwood.ai/runbooks/ops/redis-restart -> 404. anyone owning runbooks/ops pages? could we scope a quick sweep this week? :eyes:

DocScanBot: automated scan report attached — 38 hits across 7 pages. quick report: https://internal/reports/link-scan/9198765432 (contains filenames + line numbers)

Mike L: I own runbooks/ops. I'll take the high-traffic ones (redis-restart + db-failover). ping me the exact pages and I can PR fixes today.

Jess (docs): thanks mike — i'll DM you the full list. for the remaining pages, do we prefer redirects (shortlinks) or updating inbound links?

Sam T: i can open a mass-fix PR that updates inbound links in the docs repo using ripgrep + sed. example command i'll run in docs-content repo: ```rg "runbooks/ops/" -n | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u | xargs -n1 sed -i "s:/runbooks/ops/:/runbooks/running/:g"``` — will split into small PRs so QA can review. does that mapping (/runbooks/ops/ -> /runbooks/running/) look right?

Anna R.: redirects live in docs/shortlinks.yml (and we also have a netlify/_redirects fallback). migration team removed some aliases during the slug change, which is why these 404s popped up. @Leila can confirm whether the shortlinks service is configured to accept re-added aliases.

Leila: shortlinks service is up. two alias sets were intentionally removed (old experimental slugs), but the rest should be safe to restore. i can re-add aliases if we want a quick stopgap, but long-term i'd prefer updating inbound links (Sam's plan) so we don't carry tech debt. i'll need the list of exact slugs to restore if we go that route.

Jess (docs): agreed — prefer updating inbound links where possible. Mike, please prioritize redis-restart + db-failover. Sam/Anna/Leila coordinate on the rest. i'll open a tracking issue: https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/319 (will add list + priority).

Mike L: PR up for redis-restart fix: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4321 — @Jess can you review? :pray:  (fixes internal link + updates frontmatter canonical)

Jess (docs): reviewing now. quick note: include a one-line changelog note and add yourself as PR reviewer to match our audit policy.

DeployBot: staging build passed for PR #4321 — staging preview: https://staging.kb.redwood.ai/pull/4321 :white_check_mark:

Sam T: starting sed patch for remaining ~34 links. i'll slice into ~7 PRs (5 pages each) and tag reviewers. first PR should land in ~45m.

Anna R.: i'll review Sam's first PR. if everything is green, we can merge the rest in a rolling fashion.

Leila: ping me once the PRs are merged and i'll roll back unnecessary shortlink restores (if we added any). also happy to help with a small redirect if some external partners still rely on the old slug.

Jess (docs): thanks everyone. i'll update the docs-owner registry for runbooks/ops to include Mike + Anna. if anyone hits blockers (build errors, unexpected canonical conflicts), @here — post here and i'll coordinate. i'll close this thread when all PRs are merged. :thumbsup:
